name: Vine Growth
description:
Way of the Green

Thick, thorned vines erupt from the ground in a 5-ft square within Short Range. Choose one creature in that space and roll Spirit vs. Dexterity. On a win, the creature is Grappled, and your roll result becomes this spell’s Difficulty.

On each of its turns, a Grappled creature may roll Strength against the Difficulty, On a failure, it takes 1d6+HEART damage and the Difficulty increases by 2. On a pass, it escapes the vines and the Difficulty decreases by 2.

The vines persist for the duration of your Concentration, even if no creature is currently Grappled. While the vines remain:

  • Any creature that enters their space must roll Dexterity against the Difficulty or become Grappled (as above).

  • A creature adjacent to the vines may spend an Action to hack at them, reducing the Difficulty by 2.

When the spell ends, the vines wither into mundane growth but remain as difficult terrain. A creature that falls prone into the vines takes 1d6 damage.

improvements.name: Field of Vines
improvements.description: When you cast this spell, you may spend additional MP. For each additional 1 MP you spend, vines erupt in an additional 5-ft square within Short Range.
